title: Ask First Resources to publish its concession boundaries and 2026 fire report
ask: Please publish the boundary maps for all your concessions in West Kalimantan and your 2026 fire-incident report, including where each fire began.

template.body:
Dear First Resources,

Satellite data from Nusantara Atlas, as reported by The Jakarta Post, shows {{limpahSejahteraBurnedHa}} hectares burned inside the PT Limpah Sejahtera concession between January and July 2026. Satellite data does not show who started a fire, and I note your statement that some fires began outside your boundaries.

To let the public check that, I ask you to publish the boundary maps for all your concessions and your 2026 fire-incident report, including the origin of each fire and the response of your firefighting teams.

Thank you for your time.

title: Ask Singapore's environment ministry to press for action on haze at ASEAN
ask: Please state publicly whether Singapore will raise transboundary haze, and the 19 companies under field verification, at the 49th ASEAN Summit in Manila in November.

target.name: Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment (MSE)

source.title: Contact Us
source.publisher: Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment, Singapore

template.body:
Dear Minister,

Reported satellite monitoring (Nusantara Atlas, as reported by The Jakarta Post) shows at least {{burnedHaTotal}} hectares burned in Indonesia between January and July 2026, of which {{burnedHaInConcessions}} hectares were inside industrial concessions. Haze from these fires affects people across the region.

I ask whether Singapore will raise transboundary haze at the 49th ASEAN Summit in Manila in November, and whether it will ask Indonesia to publish the names of the 19 companies under field verification.

Thank you for your time.

title: Ask Indonesia's Forestry Ministry to publish the 19 company names

target.name: Kementerian Kehutanan (PPID)
target.role: Indonesian Forestry Ministry, public information office

template.body:
Dear Ministry,

Reported satellite monitoring (Nusantara Atlas, as reported by The Jakarta Post) shows at least {{burnedHaTotal}} hectares burned in Indonesia between January and July 2026, of which {{burnedHaInConcessions}} hectares were inside industrial concessions. Under the public information law, I request the names of the 19 companies under field verification and the concession permits held by each.
